name: CounterLabel
description: `CounterLabel` displays a numeric count alongside a label, such as an open-issue total. It is presentational and does not format or abbreviate the number.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name giving the count meaning, since the number alone rarely explains itself.

props.name: data-component
props.description: Overrides the marker used to identify this element in tests and styling.
